data.title: Strategy Sells More Bitcoin, Stock to Bolster Cash Stockpile
data.description: (Bloomberg) -- Michael Saylor’s Strategy Inc. spent another week revising the company’s capital structure by selling more Bitcoin and common shares to bolster its cash reserve.
